title: The osteochondral regeneration paradox: why biomimetic scaffolds are biologically superior but injectable systems dominate the clinic
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11370-11390
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09529H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sara Gubert, Harrison Moon, Nuria Oliva, Robert Texidó
This review maps osteochondral needs to design targets, comparing scaffolds vs injectable hydrogels. Scaffolds enable zonal mechanics and load bearing, but face regulatory and cost hurdles, while injectables translate easier. Created with Biorender®.
